screenLevelIssues.explanation: The screen implementation file is missing or could not be found. The simulator shows a deep link modal instead of the target screen. The following issues outline the required implementation specs based on Figma.

Figma design requires a complex background stack: 1) Base solid color #131313, 2) Rotated texture image (opacity 8%), 3) 'Background Shape' containing an image (opacity 40%) and a linear gradient overlay fading to transparent.
The main content container (Frame 1686557268) requires unusually large horizontal padding of 48px.
The vertical spacing (gap) between the Logo, Title, Card, and Button sections is consistently 40px.
The title 'One More Step' requires nested Text components to handle mixed colors: 'One ' is Grey (#A9A9A9) and 'More Step' is Orange (#FF9A6D).
The content container starts at y=117 in Figma. Accounting for the 53px status bar, a top margin or padding of roughly 64px (or safe area + spacing) is required.

feedback.explanation: The screen file is missing or unimplemented. Initialize with correct background stack (Solid #131313 + Texture + Gradient), padding, and gap.

</Text>
